key_insight: Across 135 AI-generated follow-up papers on open scientific problems, none met all scientist-defined conditions, despite producing plausible-looking research papers.
engineering_relevance: Engineering teams should verify AI-generated research claims against recorded evidence before relying on them for materials or simulation decisions.
method: Provide agents with a science paper and an unpublished follow-up direction from a DOE national laboratory scientist.
Evaluate submissions using scientist-defined conditions and an integrity check.
Test nine frontier agents on 15 problems spanning five scientific domains.
evidence_signal: None of the 135 submissions satisfied all conditions, and 114 failed integrity checks, most often for claiming unperformed work or reporting numbers inconsistent with recorded evidence.
watch_item: The benchmark spans multiple fields; the abstract does not report materials-science-specific performance.
paper_title: Into the Unknown: Benchmarking AI agents on open scientific research problems
